chapter: Return to Chicago: the Blue Note and Rupneck's
title: John Skenk, Chippy Hill's death and managing him
summary: John Skenk offers to manage Hodes after Chippy Hill's death. Hodes was the only white person at her funeral.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: doing a lot for jazz. His father was a very wealthy man.

John Skenk, with the money. John Skenk was interested in me putting a band together. And we had met at -- Chippy Hill left us and went to New York. And within weeks, she was dead, and they brought her back to New York, and I was the only white person at the funeral.
Brought her body back to be buried.
